summary: Dunmore railroad trackman, brother of Carmela "Mollie" Gianetta; John's great-grand-uncle.
bio:
Charles J. Giannetta, also recorded as Charles J. Genett, was born in 1916, one of the Giannetta children of Dunmore. His siblings were Savino (1897-1964), Mariano Martin (1899-1941), Maria (born 1902), Antonio (1907-1998), Giuseppe (1912-1971), Rosa (born 1914) and Carmela "Mollie"; he is John's great-grand-uncle. The family lived in Dunmore from at least 1910 to 1930, and Charles is probably the unnamed four-year-old son recorded there in January 1920.

By April 1940 he was 24 and a trackman on a steam railroad, living with his wife Jeanette and their baby daughter in his widowed mother's house on Sand Street in Dunmore. He died in 1975.

researchNotes:
Listed among Mollie's siblings in the FS tree (Savino 1897-1964, Mariano Martin 1899-1941, Maria 1902, Antonio 1907-1998, Giuseppe 1912-1971, Rosa 1914, Charles J. 1916-1975). The family lived in Dunmore (Ward 5) 1910-30.

In April 1940 Charles J., 24, a steam-railroad trackman, lived in his widowed mother's house at 133 Sand Street with his wife Jeanette and their baby daughter ([R4-S1]). He is probably the unnamed 4-year-old son in the January 1920 census ([R4-S2]).
